parsed.answer: Starting from a customer ID, make these calls in order: 1) GET /v1/customers/{customerId}/accounts (listCustomerAccounts) to retrieve the customer's accounts and obtain an accountId; 2) GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/statements (listStatements) to list that account's statements and obtain a statementId; 3) GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/statements/{statementId} (getStatement) to download the statement, choosing PDF or JSON via the Accept header.

Question: Starting from a customer ID, which API calls are needed to download one of their account statements?

Searches already run:
1. list customer accounts
2. download account statement

Collected excerpts:

<excerpt id="customers-api:listCustomerAccounts:operation">
[customers-api] GET /v1/customers/{customerId}/accounts · operation
operationId: listCustomerAccounts
Summary: List the accounts of a customer
Description: Returns every account held by the customer, including blocked accounts. Use the accountId values with the Accounts and Statements APIs.
Tags: Customers
Security: bearerAuth (OAuth2 bearer token in the Authorization header; scopes: customers:read) AND apiKey (API key in header X-Api-Key)
Parameters: customerId (path), X-Correlation-Id (header)
Responses: 200, 401, 403, 404, 429
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="accounts-api:listTransactions:operation">
[accounts-api] GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/transactions · operation
operationId: listTransactions
Summary: List transactions
Description: Returns the booked transactions of an account, newest first, optionally restricted to a date range. Results are paged with a cursor: pass the nextCursor of one page as the cursor of the next call.
Tags: Transactions
Security: bearerAuth (OAuth2 bearer token in the Authorization header; scopes: accounts:read) AND apiKey (API key in header X-Api-Key)
Parameters: accountId (path), X-Correlation-Id (header), fromDate (query), toDate (query), cursor (query), limit (query)
Responses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 429
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="customers-api:listConsents:operation">
[customers-api] GET /v1/customers/{customerId}/consents · operation
operationId: listConsents
Summary: List consents
Description: Returns the consents a customer has granted, together with their purpose and expiry.
Tags: Consents
Security: bearerAuth (OAuth2 bearer token in the Authorization header; scopes: customers:read) AND apiKey (API key in header X-Api-Key)
Parameters: customerId (path), X-Correlation-Id (header)
Responses: 200, 401, 403, 404, 429
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="statements-api:listStatements:operation">
[statements-api] GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/statements · operation
operationId: listStatements
Summary: List statements
Description: Returns the statements of an account for one calendar year. Statements are produced monthly, so a full year holds up to twelve entries.
Tags: Statements
Security: bearerAuth (OAuth2 bearer token in the Authorization header; scopes: statements:read) AND apiKey (API key in header X-Api-Key)
Parameters: accountId (path), X-Correlation-Id (header), year (query)
Responses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 429
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="customers-api:listCustomerAccounts:response:200">
[customers-api] GET /v1/customers/{customerId}/accounts · response 200
Response 200: The accounts held by the customer.
Headers:
- X-Correlation-Id (string): The correlation identifier of the call. It repeats the caller's value, or a generated one when none was sent.
Content application/json: array of AccountSummary
- accountId (string, required): Identifier of the account.
- iban (string, required): International bank account number.
- currency (string, required): ISO 4217 currency code of the account.
- productName (string, required): Name of the account product.
- status (string, enum OPEN|BLOCKED, required): Whether the account can be used.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="statements-api:getStatement:operation">
[statements-api] GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/statements/{statementId} · operation
operationId: getStatement
Summary: Get a statement
Description: Returns one statement either as a PDF document or as JSON. Choose the representation with the Accept header.
Tags: Statements
Security: bearerAuth (OAuth2 bearer token in the Authorization header; scopes: statements:read) AND apiKey (API key in header X-Api-Key)
Parameters: accountId (path), statementId (path), X-Correlation-Id (header)
Responses: 200, 401, 403, 404, 429
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="statements-api:getStatement:parameters">
[statements-api] GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/statements/{statementId} · parameters
- accountId (path, required, string): Identifier of the account.
- statementId (path, required, string): Identifier of the statement.
- X-Correlation-Id (header, optional, string, max length 64): Optional identifier chosen by the caller to trace a call across systems. It is echoed in the X-Correlation-Id response header and in the Problem correlationId field.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="statements-api:listStatements:response:200">
[statements-api] GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/statements · response 200
Response 200: The statements of the account for the year.
Headers:
- X-Correlation-Id (string): The correlation identifier of the call. It repeats the caller's value, or a generated one when none was sent.
Content application/json: array of StatementSummary
- statementId (string, required): Identifier of the statement.
- periodStart (string, format date, required): First day covered.
- periodEnd (string, format date, required): Last day covered.
- format (string, enum PDF|CSV, required): Format the statement was produced in.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="statements-api:getStatement:response:200">
[statements-api] GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/statements/{statementId} · response 200
Response 200: The statement in the representation selected with the Accept header.
Headers:
- X-Correlation-Id (string): The correlation identifier of the call. It repeats the caller's value, or a generated one when none was sent.
Content application/pdf: string, format binary
Content application/json: Statement
- statementId (string, required): Identifier of the statement.
- accountId (string, required): Account the statement belongs to.
- periodStart (string, format date, required): First day covered.
- periodEnd (string, format date, required): Last day covered.
- openingBalance (Amount, required)
- closingBalance (Amount, required)
- lines (array of StatementLine, required): The booked lines in the period.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="statements-api:getStatement:response:404">
[statements-api] GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/statements/{statementId} · response 404
Response 404: The account, statement or statement request does not exist. The Problem `code` is `STM-404`.
Content application/problem+json: Problem
- type (string, format uri, required): URI that identifies the kind of problem.
- title (string, required): Short, human-readable summary of the problem.
- status (integer, required): HTTP status code of the response.
- code (string, required): Lab Bank error code, for example AUTH-001.
- detail (string, required): Explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
- correlationId (string, optional): Correlation identifier of the failed call.
</excerpt>
